name: jdoe/todo-app
summary: A todo list web app. Users add, check off, and delete tasks. The website is built with React and talks to a Python Flask server that saves tasks in a database.

nodes.label: Web App
nodes.summary: The part of the project users actually see and click on. It shows the todo list and sends changes to the server.
key_points: Calls the API whenever a task changes

nodes.label: API Server
nodes.summary: The middleman between the website and the database. It receives requests like 'add this task' and handles them.

nodes.label: Data Models
nodes.summary: Defines what a 'task' looks like in code, like its title and whether it's done.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.summary: Where tasks are stored so they're still there after you close the page.

nodes.label: Setup & Dependencies
nodes.summary: Lists the libraries the project needs and how to install them.
